display_name: What an Israeli teacher is paid, and why half a post is not half the pay

generated_modules.ofek-catala.l4: GENERATED by source/build-catala-module.py from the corpus grids parsed by source/tables.py -- the same parse that produces the tables in ofek-salary-table.l4, so neither file is derived from the other. It is the eight-module encoding flattened to the Catala v1 fragment, because `l4 catala` compiles a single module. Do not edit by hand; regenerate.

scope: The pay of a classroom teacher in an Israeli primary school or junior high school employed on Ofek Hadash terms. Encoded: sections 3-7 (application and definitions), 14-33 (the 36-hour week in its ten shapes, the age reductions, the post limits, and section 31's hourly value), and 35-39 (both combined-salary tables in full, placement, seniority, the whole section 38 promotion machinery including the rank 7-9 quotas, and the role supplements) of the founding agreement of 25 December 2008; sections 4, 5, 10 and 22 of the wage agreement of 19 October 2022 (new tables, Tosefet Ofek 2022, the shekel floors, the school-role supplement); the corrected agorot appendices of the follow-up committee decision of 14 January 2025, which are AUTHORITATIVE for every number in the tables; and sections 6-9, 12, 15-20 and 24-26 of the approved collective agreement of 29 June 2026, which gives effect to the 2025-2026 wage reduction. NOT encoded, and each recorded as a fork: recognised seniority (section 37 defers to the Teachers' Service Regulations, a 770,000-character document in the corpus) and rank, both of which are INPUTS; the tables for teachers who are not academic (sections 51-53, not in the corpus); the conversion chapters (sections 43-50, 54-61); every stage and role other than a primary or junior-high classroom teacher; and the Oz LeTmura upper-secondary reform, which is a different agreement. The 205 ministry circulars are REGISTERED, with their figures, but not encoded. Law stated as at 7 September 2026. 254 scenario assertions, none failing. NOT REVIEWED -- see NOTES.md section 8 for what review would mean.

corpus_register.note: registers/document-register.json carries one row per document in the source corpus -- ALL 282 were read -- with an English title and summary, the pay components it touches, what it amends, the figures it fixes, and whatever the document flags about its own text. It is the map that decided the scope above, and it is deposited because the reasoning behind a scope decision outlives the decision. Reading it is what surfaced the 14 January 2025 correction as the authoritative source for the salary tables.

catala.note: Six worked cases are RUN through `catala interpret` against the emitted module -- no L4 in the loop -- and every one reproduces the figure ofek-cases.l4 asserts. Reproduce with source/run-catala.sh. The case scopes in catala/ofek_hadash_cases.catala_en are HAND-WRITTEN, because l4 catala does not lower this module's #ASSERT directives into Catala #[test] scopes; that is fork F12, with minimal reproductions in NOTES.md section 7.

not_reviewed.note: No report/ and no gates/: no human gate has been granted OR waived, which is a weaker position than a waiver. Nobody who knows Israeli teachers' pay has read this against the agreements. NOTES.md section 8 names the four things such a reader would have to settle, of which forks F1 (what a merged table cell means), F3 (the section 38(g)/38(i) deadlock) and F9 (which Tosefet Ofek enters the section 39(b) base) are the ones that change answers.

findings.F11: The combined-salary table is GENERATED by the two percentages printed in its own margins. Applying 2% down seniority rows 2-7, 1% from row 8, and 7.5% across the ranks to the base cell reproduces all 224 separately-printed cells of both tables, worst deviation 0.005 over the whole grid on the agorot printing. Encoded as 20 assertions.
findings.F13: `l4 catala` emits a module `catala typecheck` rejects, and exits 0 while doing it. An @export'd function lowers to a Catala SCOPE, and catala allows a scope call only from inside another scope, so what fails is a scope called from a NON-exported toplevel definition -- here `the full-post percentage base for`, whose caller `the supplement for one slot of` at ofek-catala.l4:492 is not exported. CORRECTED 2026-09-07: an earlier wording of this finding said @export is not composable in the Catala backend, and that was FALSE. Exporting a helper is fine provided every caller of it is exported too; putting @export on all 28 definitions that take a GIVEN emits 43 scopes, typechecks, and returns the same six case figures digit for digit. The single @export is a choice, not a limitation. Filed upstream 2026-09-07 as smucclaw/l4-ide#958, against the silence rather than the composition. See registers/fork-register.json F13 and NOTES.md section 7.3(b).
